start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that the person's connection to a place still reaches its account, before a post is set to go there or a read is made", with {"place":"threads","account_id":"service_connection:threads"}. It runs tool:check-a-connection; its answer contains "id".
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check that the person's connection to a place still reaches its account, before a post is set to go there or a read is made", and give it place (the slug of a place that declares a check, here threads) and account_id (One of the person's accounts of that place's kind, from tool:list-post-destinations).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-a-connection and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Asks the place which account the person's connection signs in as, with the value the person's vault holds for it (placed only as the request leaves, never shown).
